quotes.name: Alexa Ward
quotes.quote: I haven't moved into a new place recently. I've been living in West Oakland for a while now.

quotes.name: Sidney Tumolo
quotes.quote: The gathering was really nice, I ended up staying longer than I planned. It was great catching up with folks from around the neighborhood.

quotes.name: Bruce Turner
quotes.quote: I heard another neighbor was between jobs and it didn't really surprise me, to be honest. The neighborhood's been a bit subdued lately, with some storefronts looking quieter than usual. It's just one of those things you notice when you're around.

claim: I haven't moved into a new place recently. I've been living in West Oakland for a while now.
